diagnostics.objective: unpenalized mean negative log likelihood in original time units

generation.algorithm: Bernoulli purchases with dropout before each opportunity

fixed_pq_convention: Finite-state forward masses for one stored pattern. p is purchase probability; q is dropout probability. Zero likelihood has log_likelihood=null and undefined conditionals=null; status=zero_likelihood identifies this case.

metadata.likelihood_convention: One binary pattern with given x and last purchase tx; no combinatorial multiplicity. Customers start active at time zero; dropout precedes each opportunity. Fixed log_likelihood is per history; weight multiplies only the fit total.
metadata.mean_convention: Purchases over opportunities n+1 through n+horizon.

model_source.title: Customer-Base Analysis in a Discrete-Time Noncontractual Setting

metadata.numerical_note: The package initializes the dropout sum with 1e-15 before beta normalization. Library outputs retain that floor. Finite-state checks report its bias.
metadata.probability_convention: Alive at opportunity n+1, including survival before that opportunity; conditional_probability_alive is called with m_periods_in_future=1, independently of horizon.

tolerances.justification: Fixed values use moderate finite inputs. MLE checks allow optimizer stopping differences; the total objective and independently differenced gradient must also agree.
